rationale: Recommend no. EO 13204 (66 FR 11228, February 17, 2001; held official text) revoked EO 12933 and directed rescission of its implementing rules; the held Federal Register text of EO 13495 (74 FR 6103) states in its section 7 that Executive Order 13204 of February 17, 2001 is revoked and, in its section 10, that it becomes effective immediately, signed January 30, 2009. No earlier whole-order end appears, no savings clause revives the order, and the order was not in force on 2026-10-14; only the first end of its section 2 is not established.
